content.title: Lamar Odom
content.text: From Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Lamar Odom with the Lakers Lamar Joseph Odom (born November 6, 1979) is an American basketball player.[1] His team, the Los Angeles Lakers, won the NBA Championships in 2009 and 2010. He has also played basketball for the Los Angeles Clippers, Dallas Mavericks, Miami Heat and the Spanish team Laboral Kutxa. Odom was born in South Jamaica, Queens. Between 2009 and 2013 he was married to television star Khloe Kardashian.[2] The couple has since split. On October 13, 2015, Odom was hospitalized after being discovered unconscious at the Love Ranch South brothel in Crystal, Nevada.[3] He was in a coma and placed on life support in a hospital in Las Vegas for a few days before regaining consciousness. He had suffered several strokes and kidney failure.[4] He was transferred from Las Vegas to a Los Angeles hospital by medical transport.[5] ↑ Marc Stein. "Sources: Heat Prepared to Offer Odom".
